answer: Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 90 epochs of grading, and every falcon settlement recomputes the timber schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 90 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
